description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_pusch_demodulator_decorator', a decorator for PUSCH demodulator that adds metrics collection and notification functionality.

classes.name: phy_metrics_pusch_demodulator_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for pusch_demodulator that adds metrics measurement and notification.

methods.name: phy_metrics_pusch_demodulator_decorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a base demodulator and a notifier.

methods.name: demodulate
methods.description: Performs demodulation, measures CPU usage, and notifies metrics.

methods.description: Returns a view of the next block of log-likelihood ratios.

methods.description: Handles new block data, measures elapsed time.

methods.description: Handles end of codeword event, measures elapsed time.
